decisions.reason: As a peripheral consumer product with weaker fit to the firm's technology-led core, it would likely be dropped if its results stayed below aspiration so resources can be redirected to more promising ventures.

Because it extends the firm's established waste-to-energy offering and can leverage existing customers and capabilities, management would likely keep it while results remain uncertain but acceptable relative to aspiration.

As a flagship product squarely in the firm's strategic core, it is likely to be retained because management would tolerate early uncertainty and continue search and refinement unless performance clearly falls short of aspiration.
Its flagship status and close fit with the firm's sustainable conversion direction make continued commitment more likely, even if commercialization is still uncertain.
